title: XTRA POWER Arc Welding Machine, 200A
description: The XTRA POWER Arc Welding Machine XP-WM 200A is a robust and reliable welding solution for your metalworking needs. With a powerful 200-ampere output, this machine delivers consistent performance for various welding applications. The compact design makes it easily portable around your workshop, while the sturdy construction ensures durability in demanding work environments. This arc welder features smooth arc initiation and stable arc maintenance, allowing for precise control and professional-quality welds. Whether you're working on mild steel, stainless steel, or other compatible metals, this welding machine provides the versatility needed for different projects. The unit comes with essential controls for adjusting current settings, enabling you to achieve optimal welding parameters for different material thicknesses. Ideal for both DIY enthusiasts and professional welders, this XTRA POWER machine combines functionality with reliability for your welding requirements.
